title: Sculpture & Antiquity
description: Marble, bronze, and stone — the enduring forms of the ancient and classical world.

items.title: Bronze statuette of a philosopher on a lamp stand
items.description_narrative: This bronze statuette depicts a philosopher, crafted with intricate detail. The figure is integrated into a lamp stand, a common functional object in its time.
items.tags: bronze, statuette, philosopher, lamp stand, roman, ancient, sculpture, figurative

items.title: The Death of Socrates
items.description_narrative: Jacques Louis David's iconic work depicts the philosopher Socrates, surrounded by his students, at the moment he chooses to drink hemlock rather than compromise his ideals. This powerful scene embodies the stoic virtue and moral integrity central to classical antiquity, rendered with precise draughtsmanship and dramatic intensity.
items.tags: history painting, Neoclassicism, classical, philosophy, death, sacrifice, ancient Greece, moral virtue

items.title: The Fieschi Morgan Staurotheke
items.medium: Gilded silver, gold, enamel worked in cloisonné, and niello
items.description_narrative: This magnificent staurotheke, a reliquary for a fragment of the True Cross, exemplifies the exquisite craftsmanship of the early 9th century Byzantine Empire. Fashioned from gilded silver, gold, and intricate cloisonné enamel, it showcases the era's dedication to sacred art and precious materials.
items.tags: byzantine, reliquary, metalwork, gold, enamel, early medieval, religious

items.title: Portrait of a Woman, Possibly a Nun of San Secondo; (verso) Scene in Grisaille
items.medium: Oil on wood; (verso: oil and gold on wood)
items.description_narrative: This intimate oil on wood portrait, likely depicting a nun from San Secondo, was created by Jacometto Veneziano between approximately 1485 and 1495. The reverse of the panel features a grisaille scene, showcasing the artist's versatility with oil and gold on wood.
items.tags: portrait, Renaissance, oil painting, grisaille, religious, Italian, detailed

items.title: Portrait of Alvise Contarini(?); (verso) A Tethered Roebuck
items.medium: Oil on wood; verso: oil and gold on wood
items.description_narrative: This double-sided artwork presents a potential portrait of Alvise Contarini on one panel, meticulously rendered in oil on wood. The verso reveals a detailed depiction of a tethered roebuck, executed in oil and gold on wood.
items.tags: portrait, Renaissance, Venetian, oil painting, animal, wood panel, double-sided

items.title: The Horse Fair
items.description_narrative: Rosa Bonheur's monumental canvas, "The Horse Fair," depicts a bustling market scene where powerful, muscular horses are presented for sale. This work celebrates the strength and beauty of these animals, showcasing the artist's meticulous observation and mastery of realist painting.
items.tags: horses, animals, market, realism, 19th century, French art, monumental, oil painting

items.title: Oedipus and the Sphinx
items.description_narrative: Gustave Moreau's *Oedipus and the Sphinx* dramatically illustrates the pivotal encounter between the mythological hero and the monstrous Sphinx. The painting is emblematic of Moreau's Symbolist style, emphasizing intricate detail and a mystical atmosphere as Oedipus confronts the creature's riddle.
items.tags: mythology, symbolism, oedipus, sphinx, mystical, allegory, french art

items.title: Mirror-bearer
items.description_narrative: This intricately carved wooden figure, known as a mirror-bearer, likely served a ceremonial purpose in ancient Maya society. Crafted from Cordia wood and adorned with red hematite, it embodies the sophisticated artistry characteristic of the Classic Maya period.
items.tags: maya, sculpture, wooden, pre-columbian, ceremonial, figure, ancient

items.title: Commode à vantaux
items.medium: Oak, pine, walnut, mahogany, and cherry veneered with hornbeam (partially stained), tulipwood, walnut, holly and maple (both partially stained), boxwood, mahogany, and other woods; red brocatelle marble; gilt bronze; iron, steel, and brass
items.description_narrative: This ornate commode, crafted by David Roentgen, exemplifies the intricate artistry of 18th-century European furniture design. It features a luxurious combination of veneered woods, red brocatelle marble, and gilt bronze, showcasing master craftsmanship.
items.tags: commode, furniture, woodworking, marquetry, luxury, 18th century, european, decorative arts

items.title: Commode (commode à vantaux) (part of a set)
items.medium: Oak veneered with ebony, amaranth, holly, ebonized holly, satinwood, Japanese and French lacquer panels; gilt-bronze mounts, brocatelle marble top (not original); steel springs; morocco leather (not original)
items.description_narrative: This elegant commode, created by Adam Weisweiler around 1790, showcases a sophisticated blend of luxurious materials. It features intricate veneering with ebony, amaranth, and satinwood, enhanced by exquisite Japanese and French lacquer panels and opulent gilt-bronze mounts.
items.tags: commode, furniture, neoclassical, veneered, lacquer, gilt-bronze, decorative arts, elegant

items.title: Mantel clock with musical movement
items.medium: Case: gilded and lacquered bronze and marble; Movement (in bust): brass and steel with enameled hour and minute chapter rings (in head); Miniature organ with pipes and bellows (in base): brass, steel, and leather
items.description_narrative: This intricate mantel clock with a musical movement was crafted by Jean-Baptiste-André Furet around 1784. Its opulent case is composed of gilded and lacquered bronze and marble, housing a brass and steel movement in the bust and a miniature organ with pipes and bellows in its base.
items.tags: mantel clock, musical instrument, gilded bronze, marble, horology, decorative arts, 18th century, intricate

items.title: Drop-front secretary on stand (secrètaire à abattant or secrétaire en cabinet) (one of a pair) (part of a set)
items.medium: Oak veneered with ebony, amaranth, holly, ebonized holly, satinwood, Japanese and French lacquer panels, gilt-bronze mounts, brocatelle marble top (not original); steel springs; morocco leather (not original)
items.description_narrative: This intricate drop-front secretary, crafted by Adam Weisweiler, showcases luxurious materials including ebony, amaranth, holly, and Japanese lacquer panels. Its elaborate gilt-bronze mounts and elegant design reflect the sophisticated taste of its era.
items.tags: furniture, secretary, cabinet, ebony, lacquer, gilt-bronze, french, neoclassical

items.title: Commode
items.medium: Walnut veneered with ebony, marquetry of engraved brass and tortoiseshell, gilt-bronze mounts, verd antique marble
items.description_narrative: This commode exemplifies luxury furniture of the early 18th century, crafted with opulent materials like ebony, engraved brass, and tortoiseshell. Its distinctive marquetry technique, known as Boulle work, creates intricate patterns that highlight the grandeur of the piece.
items.tags: furniture, commode, marquetry, baroque, decorative arts, french, luxury, gilt-bronze

items.title: Jewish Woman of Algiers
items.medium: Algerian onyx-marble, bronze, gilt bronze, enamel, and amethyst eyes; white marble socle
items.description_narrative: Charles-Henri-Joseph Cordier's 1862 sculpture, "Jewish Woman of Algiers," masterfully combines diverse materials to create a vivid figure. This polychrome work, crafted from Algerian onyx-marble, bronze, gilt bronze, enamel, and amethyst, reflects 19th-century ethnographic interests.
items.tags: sculpture, portrait, algerian, polychrome, academic, ethnographic, 19th century, figure

items.title: Marble statue of Eirene (the personification of peace)
items.description_narrative: This marble statue depicts Eirene, the personification of peace, in a classical pose. Crafted during the Roman period, it embodies the symbolic representation of tranquility.
items.tags: eirene, peace, roman, sculpture, marble, classical, personification

items.title: Antelope Head
items.description_narrative: This finely carved sculpture depicts an antelope head, meticulously crafted from greywacke, travertine, and agate. Dating from the Late Period, its composite materials highlight the skill of ancient artisans.
items.tags: antelope, animal sculpture, ancient, egyptian, stone, carving, artifact, late period

items.title: Sphinx of Amenhotep III, possibly from a Model of a Temple
items.medium: Faience, remains of a travertine (Egyptian alabaster) tenon
items.description_narrative: This faience sphinx, possibly from a model temple, depicts Pharaoh Amenhotep III. Its vibrant material and detailed form represent a significant artistic achievement of the New Kingdom.
items.tags: sphinx, amenhotep iii, ancient egypt, faience, sculpture, pharaoh, new kingdom

items.title: Head of a Hippopotamus
items.medium: Travertine (Egyptian alabaster) with traces of gesso and red pigment
items.description_narrative: Carved from travertine, this sculpture depicts the head of a hippopotamus, showing subtle traces of gesso and red pigment on its surface. This ancient artifact offers a glimpse into the artistry and animal representations of its distant era.
items.tags: hippopotamus, sculpture, ancient, egyptian, animal, travertine, artifact, zoomorphic
